capabilities: generate tags for the current note using OpenAI or Claude
batch-process all notes in the vault
preview and select tags before applying them
match AI-generated tags against existing vault tags
configure prompts, tag limits, rate limits and retries
extras: The manifest carries a warning that the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. README notes that batch processing large vaults can consume significant API credits and that note content is sent to the AI provider.
problem: Obsidian tags are added manually, so tagging many notes consistently is slow and error-prone.
